svg.title: Business group-average p50 after message bursts
svg.desc: Four burst sizes, all queues, identical horizontal scale. Mean of three runs of p50 of 16-call business group averages, not single-call latency.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(95%,96%,98%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Business execution while messages are backlogged
Same scale in all panels. Lower is better. All four queues and displayed burst sizes are included.
